import re

text = "What are the methods to [request] assistance for a community clean-up?"
synonyms = {
    "request": "ask for",
}

def replace_bracketed(text, synonyms):
    def repl(match):
        word = match.group(1)
        return synonyms.get(word, word)
    return re.sub(r"\[([^\]]+)\]", repl, text)

print(replace_bracketed(text, synonyms))
